references.text: Psalm 127:1 also compares work done without God's support to futile labor, similar to the meaningless act of building a house on sand in Matthew 7:26.
Isaiah 28:16 speaks of laying a cornerstone in Zion, a sure foundation stone. This stands in contrast to the poor foundation mentioned in Matthew 7:26.
Proverbs 10:25 mentions how the wicked are like a passing storm, which can be compared to the house built on sand in Matthew 7:26.
Luke 6:47-49 provides a parallel to Jesus' parable in Matthew 7:24-27, including verse 26, about building houses on rock and sand respectively.
